list.title: Free In-Home Estimate
list.text: We come to you, assess the space, and give you a detailed written estimate before any work begins — no pressure, no obligation.

list.title: Licensed & Insured
list.text: Fully licensed general contractor, bonded and insured. We provide proof before any job — most homeowners ask and we expect it.

list.title: Quality Materials Only
list.text: We work with name-brand tile, cabinetry, and fixtures. No budget substitutions without your explicit approval.

list.title: On-Time & On-Budget
list.text: We set a written schedule before we start and stick to it. If something changes, you hear about it before it shows up on an invoice.

list.title: Custom Design Help
list.text: From a simple refresh to a full gut renovation, we offer design guidance to help you get the most out of every dollar spent.

list.title: Clean Jobsite Daily
list.text: We clean up at the end of every workday. Your home stays livable while we work — no debris left overnight.
